command_summary: claude --print --permission-mode plan --tools Read,Grep,Glob --no-session-persistence --no-chrome --strict-mcp-config --setting-sources project --model claude-opus-5-5 --effort medium

style_authority.note: Reads the surface as an operations sheet with 'calm utility-grade motion' and rejects whole-sheet scale because it 'works against keeping context'; motion policy is checked before tuning.

reference_selection.note: Explicitly names design-craft/SKILL.md and references/interaction-physics.md and applies them (interruptibility rule, spring, projection, rubber-band); design-system references are not visibly selected beyond token-free handle styling.

anti_generic_redesign.note: Limits motion to 'only two parts' and bans content fades/staggers and transition: all, but M4's optional 'damping 0.8 ... should overshoot slightly' reopens decorative bounce for a calm utility UI.

evidence_level.note: States 'static only' and that every 'feel' claim is an unverified inference; performance gates are 'provisional', and the ~300 ms lag is listed under 'Inferred but not verified'.

verified_boundary.note: Three-tier list (verified from source, inferred but not verified, not claimed) explicitly excludes Reduced Motion, browser and performance validation; F1's freeze is hedged as 'probably' with an Unknown line.

design_moves.note: Most concrete moves: primary-pointer capture, grab offset, 10 px threshold, rAF translateY writes, touch-action handoff, removing the animating lock and fill:forwards, spring with velocity conversion, gated projection with one-state-skip limit, rubber-band formula and Reduced Motion cross-fade. No explicit hysteresis.

scope_control.note: Within limits (149 of 150 lines, five findings, eight moves) but runs at the ceiling and adds peripheral items (44 px hit target, aria-expanded button semantics) that dilute the motion focus.
